text: Who was the father of John the Baptist?
explanation: Zechariah, a priest, was the father of John.

text: God created the world in ______ days.
explanation: Creation took 6 days; God rested on the 7th.

text: Who betrayed Jesus?
explanation: Judas betrayed Jesus for 30 pieces of silver.

text: The Sermon on the Mount is found in the book of ______.
explanation: Matthew chapters 5-7.

text: Who led the Israelites out of Egypt?
explanation: Moses was chosen by God for the Exodus.

text: The first murder in the Bible was committed by ______.
explanation: Cain killed his brother Abel.

text: Which disciple denied Jesus three times?
explanation: Peter denied knowing Jesus before the rooster crowed.

text: Jesus was born in ______.
explanation: Bethlehem of Judea.

text: Who built the Ark?
explanation: Noah built the Ark to escape the flood.

text: The Holy Spirit descended on the disciples on the day of ______.
explanation: Pentecost marks the coming of the Holy Spirit.

text: Who is known as the father of faith?
explanation: Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness.

text: The Ten Commandments were given on Mount ______.
explanation: Moses received the laws on Mt. Sinai.

text: Jesus turned water into wine at ______.
explanation: The wedding at Cana was His first miracle.

text: Who was the mother of Samuel?
explanation: Hannah prayed for a son and dedicated him to God.

text: David killed the giant named ______.
explanation: Goliath was the Philistine champion.

text: Which king asked God for wisdom?
explanation: Solomon chose wisdom over riches.

text: The Lord's Prayer is found in Matthew chapter ______.
explanation: Matthew 6:9-13.

text: Who was thrown into the lion's den?
explanation: Daniel was punished for praying to God.

text: The first five books of the Bible are called the ______.
explanation: Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy.

text: Who baptized Jesus?
explanation: In the River Jordan.

text: The prodigal son asked his father for ______.
explanation: He took his share of the estate and left.

text: Who is the comforter promised by Jesus?
explanation: Jesus promised the Holy Spirit to guide believers.

text: God tested Abraham by asking him to sacrifice ______.
explanation: Isaac was the son of promise.

text: The wife of Isaac was ______.
explanation: Rebekah was chosen for Isaac.

text: How many disciples did Jesus have?
explanation: The twelve apostles.

text: Who climbed a sycamore tree to see Jesus?
explanation: Zacchaeus was a short tax collector.

text: The Bible is divided into ______ parts.
explanation: Old Testament and New Testament.

text: Who was the first king of Israel?
explanation: Saul was anointed by Samuel.

text: Jesus fed 5000 people with ______.
explanation: A boy's lunch was multiplied.

text: The commandment 'Honor thy father and thy mother' is the ______ commandment.
explanation: The 5th commandment (with a promise).

text: Who translated the Bible into English?
explanation: Tyndale was a pioneer translator.

text: The story of the Good Samaritan teaches about ______.
explanation: Helping those in need regardless of background.

text: Who was sold into slavery by his brothers?
explanation: Joseph was sold to Egypt.

text: The shortest verse in the Bible is ______.
explanation: John 11:35.

text: Who replaced Judas Iscariot?
explanation: Chosen by lot in Acts 1.

text: Which city did Jonah refuse to go to?
explanation: He fled to Tarshish instead of Nineveh.

text: The name 'Jesus' means ______.
explanation: He will save His people from their sins.

text: Who was the mother of Jesus?
explanation: Virgin Mary.

text: The last book of the Bible is ______.
explanation: Revelation of John.

text: Who killed Abel?
explanation: Cain was the first murderer.

text: The fruits of the Spirit are ______.
explanation: Love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control.

text: Moses received the Ten Commandments on two tablets of ______.
explanation: Written by the finger of God on stone.

text: Who brought Christianity to Nigeria?
explanation: European missionaries (CMS, etc.) introduced the faith.

text: The temptation of Jesus lasted for ______ days.
explanation: He fasted 40 days and nights.

text: Who interpreted Pharaoh's dreams?
explanation: Joseph's interpretation saved Egypt from famine.

text: The promised land was ______.
explanation: Land flowing with milk and honey.

text: Who raised Lazarus from the dead?
explanation: One of Jesus' greatest miracles.

text: The twin brother of Jacob was ______.
explanation: Esau sold his birthright to Jacob.

text: Who was the strongest man in the Bible?
explanation: Samson's strength was in his hair (Nazarite vow).

text: Jesus was crucified at ______.
explanation: Golgotha (Place of the Skull).

text: The first martyr in the Bible was ______.
explanation: Stephen was stoned to death in Acts.

text: Who denied Jesus?
explanation: Peter claimed not to know Him.

text: The wise men brought gifts of ______.
explanation: Gifts for the newborn King.

text: Who led the Israelites across the Jordan River?
explanation: Joshua succeeded Moses.

text: The book of Psalms was mostly written by ______.
explanation: King David is the primary psalmist.

text: Who was swallowed by a big fish?
explanation: Jonah spent 3 days in the belly of the fish.

text: Faith is the substance of things ______.
explanation: Hebrews 11:1.

text: Who was the tax collector that became a disciple?
explanation: Matthew (Levi) left his tax booth.

text: The greatest commandment is ______.
explanation: Love God with all your heart...

text: Who defeated the prophets of Baal?
explanation: On Mount Carmel.

text: Which disciple doubted the resurrection?
explanation: Doubting Thomas needed to see the nail marks.

text: The armor of God includes the ______ of faith.
explanation: Shield of Faith (Ephesians 6).

text: Who was the first woman created?
explanation: Eve was made from Adam's rib.

text: Jesus rose on the ______ day.
explanation: Resurrection Sunday.

text: Paul was formerly known as ______.
explanation: Saul of Tarsus became Paul.

text: Who wrote the Acts of the Apostles?
explanation: Luke, the physician.

text: The rich man and ______.
explanation: Parable of the Rich Man and Lazarus.

text: Who was the 'father of many nations'?
explanation: God's covenant with Abraham.

text: The golden rule says: Do unto others as ______.

options.B: You would have them do to you

explanation: Matthew 7:12.

text: Repentance means ______.
explanation: A change of heart and mind.
